placement_candidates.max_evaluations: Maximum anchors whose placement is evaluated in this call. Defaults to 64; hard maximum 256. Independent of returned limit and maxCells.
placement_candidates.scan_offset: Zero-based row-major anchor offset within the same rectangle. Defaults to 0. Continue with nextOffset; each page is independently observed and ranked.
placement_candidates.limit: Maximum candidate rows returned. Defaults to 8; hard maximum 50. This does not bound placement evaluation work.
placement_candidates.max_cells: Maximum cells in the requested rectangle. Default and hard maximum 2500. Evaluation work is separately bounded by maxEvaluations.
placement_candidates.scope_note: Candidates, ranking and counts cover only this call's evaluated window. bestCandidate is the best observed anchor in that window; successful preview does not guarantee native placement or completed construction.
placement_candidates.next_partial: More anchors remain unobserved. Repeat the same rectangle and settings with scanOffset={0}; pages are not an atomic snapshot.
placement_candidates.no_viable: No viable anchor was observed in this window. Inspect rejected previews or choose another rectangle or settings.
placement_candidates.offset_error: scanOffset must be between 0 and {0} for this rectangle.
placement_candidates.invalid_rect: Invalid candidate rectangle: width and height must be positive.
tools.building_control.parameters.maxEva: Maximum anchors whose placement is evaluated in this call. Defaults to 64; hard maximum 256. Independent of returned limit and maxCells.
tools.building_control.parameters.scanOf: Zero-based row-major anchor offset within the same rectangle. Defaults to 0. Continue with nextOffset; each page is independently observed and ranked.
